title: Requirements for establishment and epigenetic stability of mammalian heterochromatin
model: Mouse ES cells, inducible H3K9me3 reporter, custom 1,310-gene chromatin CRISPR-KO library
contrast: eGFP+ vs unsorted, establishment screen, paired by replicate (2 vs 2); maintenance screen run separately
paper_calls: H3K9 and DNA methyltransferases, HDACs, remodelers and RNA-processing factors establish and maintain silencing; DHX9 required for maintenance via R-loops
barcs_calls: Establishment: 106 genes at FDR 0.10 (47 enriched; 217 against the control null). Maintenance: 164 (309 against the control null; calibrated).
named_hits: Establishment enriched: Dnmt1 #2, Setdb1 #7, Ehmt2 #13, Dnmt3b #35, Dnmt3a #39 (all FDR<=0.064), Suv39h1 #48 (FDR 0.12); Hdac1/Hdac2 not enriched; Dhx9 depleted. Maintenance enriched: Dnmt3l #1, Uhrf1 #3, Dnmt3a #4, Dnmt1 #5, Setdb1 #35; Dhx9 #143 (ns).
verdict: BARCS reproduces the establishment screen closely: every methyltransferase the paper names is enriched at FDR 0.10 and the gene ranking correlates 0.88 with the authors' MAGeCK (46/50 top genes shared). HDACs are a named class, not individual hits, and Hdac1 is depleted at the guide level. DHX9 is recovered in neither screen at FDR.
